title: Lost and Found
theme: Lost things, lost characters and lost worlds
intro: [gasps] Has anybody seen my keys? No? [laughs] Well, welcome to LOST AND FOUND, where Disney characters lose everything: shoes, shadows, sons, even entire cities. Let's go find some points!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A cozy old lost-and-found office with wooden shelves piled with umbrellas, hats, a lonely teddy bear, a single sparkly shoe and a brass bell on the counter, warm lamplight.

categories.title: Lost Boys and Shadows
categories.intro: Our film category is Peter Pan, a movie FULL of lost things. [chuckles] Second star to the right, and straight on till points.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A moonlit nursery window flung open over a sleepy London skyline, a curtain fluttering, a sewing kit on the sill and a shadowy silhouette slipping across the floor.

clues.clue: At the start of Peter Pan, Peter comes back to the Darling house looking for this, which Wendy later sews back on.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is his shadow! [laughs] Only Peter Pan could lose something that's attached to his feet.

clues.clue: Captain Hook lost his hand to this animal, which now follows him everywhere.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a crocodile! [mischievously] He liked the taste of Hook so much, he wants seconds.

clues.clue: Why does the crocodile go tick-tock? Because it swallowed one of these.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a clock! [chuckles] Hook's own early-warning system.

clues.clue: Peter Pan's gang of Lost Boys has this many members in the 1953 film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is six! Slightly, Cubby, Nibs, Tootles and the Twins. [laughs] The twins count as two. I checked.

clues.clue: The Lost Boys' secret underground hideout is hidden inside this spooky-sounding tree.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hangman's Tree! [whispers] Step inside a knothole and slide down to the hideout. Best. Fort. Ever.

categories.title: Misplaced Items
categories.intro: Disney characters are TERRIBLE at keeping track of things. [sighs] Tell me what got lost, or where it ended up.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sunken treasure chest on a sandy sea floor spilling a jumble of lost objects: a fishhook, a guitar, a leather journal, a tiny toy cowboy boot, light rays from above.

clues.clue: In Finding Nemo, Nemo is scooped up by a diver and ends up in a fish tank in this kind of office.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a dentist's office! [laughs] Sydney's scariest tank, thanks to a kid named Darla.

clues.clue: In Toy Story 2, Woody is taken by this greedy toy collector who dresses up as a chicken on TV.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Al! [sarcastic] Selling a toy to a museum in Japan. How dare he.

clues.clue: In Moana, Maui's lost magical fishhook ends up in this realm of monsters.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Lalotai! [gasps] A whole upside-down world of monsters. Not a great spot to drop your keys.

clues.clue: In Coco, Miguel ends up in the Land of the Dead after taking this from Ernesto de la Cruz's tomb.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is his guitar! [chuckles] Turns out, borrowing from the dead is a big no-no.

clues.clue: In Atlantis: The Lost Empire, Milo uses this book to guide the expedition to the lost city.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Shepherd's Journal! Milo can read Atlantean, too. Nerds save the world AGAIN.

categories.title: Lost and Found Bin
categories.intro: It's a zoom category! I've zoomed WAY in on something left in our lost and found bin. [mischievously] Tell me who it belongs to.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A big wooden lost-and-found crate overflowing with a frying pan, a fork, a honey pot, a deerstalker cap, a pocket watch and a top hat, under a single hanging lightbulb.

clues.clue: Someone left this shiny gold oil lamp in the bin. Who lives inside it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Genie! [laughs] Phenomenal cosmic powers... itty bitty living space.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up, Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. An ornate golden oil lamp with a curled spout resting on red velvet in a desert cave, glittering treasure and golden coins softly blurred behind it.

clues.clue: This heavy cookware was found in the bin. Who uses it as a weapon?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rapunzel! Frying pans! Who knew, right? [chuckles] Flynn Rider did not see it coming.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up, Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sturdy cast-iron frying pan with a long handle propped against a tower window, purple flowers and paint brushes nearby.

clues.clue: Someone lost this shiny dinglehopper. Who's it belong to?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ariel! [laughs] Scuttle says it's for combing your hair. We say it's a fork.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up, Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A silver dinner fork lying among seashells and coral on a sandy rock, sparkling under rippling water light.

clues.clue: Found in the bin: this checked cap and magnifying glass. Who's the tiny detective?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Basil of Baker Street! [excited] The Great Mouse Detective himself. Elementary, my dear Dawson.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up, Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A tiny brown deerstalker cap and a brass magnifying glass on a desk, next to a miniature violin and a scattering of cheese crumbs.

clues.clue: This gold pocket watch, smeared with butter and jam, was left behind. Who lost it?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the White Rabbit! [sighs] The Mad Hatter buttered it to fix it. Now he's REALLY late.

media.prompt: Extreme close-up, Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A gold pocket watch open on a cluttered tea-party table, its face smeared with butter and strawberry jam, teacups and a tiny white glove beside it.

categories.title: Lost Worlds
categories.intro: Disney parks are full of lost temples, lost mountains and lost explorers. [whispers] Stay close, and don't wander off.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A misty jungle river winding past crumbling stone temple ruins overgrown with vines, a rickety rope bridge and a distant snow-capped mountain, golden adventure lighting.

clues.clue: At Epcot's The Seas pavilion, you ride a clamshell to help find this lost clownfish.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Nemo! The Seas with Nemo and Friends. [laughs] That kid gets lost more than my car keys.

clues.clue: In Magic Kingdom's Adventureland, you can climb a giant treehouse built by this shipwrecked family.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Swiss Family Robinson! [chuckles] Lost at sea? Just build a mansion in a tree. With running water!

clues.clue: Disneyland's Indiana Jones Adventure takes you into a lost temple of this goddess.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mara! Temple of the Forbidden Eye. [whispers] Whatever you do... don't look into her eyes.

clues.clue: At Hong Kong Disneyland's Mystic Manor, Lord Henry Mystic's mischievous pet monkey is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Albert! [mischievously] He opens a magical music box and EVERYTHING comes to life. Classic monkey move.

clues.clue: Tokyo DisneySea's jungle port, home of Indiana Jones Adventure: Temple of the Crystal Skull, is called Lost blank Delta.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is River! Lost River Delta. [excited] Bring a map, and maybe a whip.

categories.title: Missing Persons
categories.intro: Our fan category: Missing Persons! These characters went missing, got lost or are searching for somebody. [dramatic pause] Who are they?

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A wall of an old explorers' office pinned with blank wanted-style posters, a hand-drawn map with red string, a brass compass and an oil lamp.

clues.clue: In Encanto, the Madrigal family doesn't talk about this missing uncle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bruno! [whispers] No, no, no... we don't talk about him. He was living in the walls the whole time!

clues.clue: In Up, Russell names the rare, lost giant bird they find in South America this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kevin! [laughs] And then it turns out Kevin is a girl. A mom, actually.

clues.clue: In Hercules, baby Hercules is kidnapped from Mount Olympus on the orders of this god.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hades! [sarcastic] Sending Pain and Panic to do a job. What could possibly go wrong?

clues.clue: In The Rescuers, Bernard and Bianca search for this missing orphan girl.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Penny! The Rescue Aid Society to the rescue! [chuckles] Size doesn't matter when you've got heart.

clues.clue: In Finding Dory, Dory searches for her long-lost parents. Name them.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Jenny and Charlie! [sighs] They left a trail of shells for her, every single day. Grab the tissues.
